name: Owned checkpoint wait in worker resumption
summary: Owned work and the host resume queue expose bounded literal blocker/dependency text, source and next action from the exact caller's latest validated checkpoint. Exact actor attribution, historical/current status, review precedence, unknown histories, omission counts and escaped control text remain explicit. A person is never inferred. Reads acknowledge nothing and reuse the queue's linked checkpoint parse without another native query. The move sentence beside it in the same queue row says the caller recorded a blocker or dependency in its own checkpoint, quotes that checkpoint's own words with the double quote and newline escaped, and keeps the move and the count the caller's, so the two read as one thing and a second line cannot read as a move. The additive reconciliation-needed state beside the row clears no blocker and changes no wait: the recorded wait, its items and the caller's move stand.
